results = []

    index += N
    P = list(map(int, data[index:index + N]))
    index += N
    Q = int(data[index])
    index += 1

        op = data[index]
        index += 1

            B = [0] * N
            for i in range(N):
                B[P[i] - 1] = A[i]
            A = B
        elif op == '2':
            x = int(data[index]) - 1

            index += 1

for result in results:
